summary: This 1A Auto guide on torque wrenches explains how to apply correct rotational force to automotive fasteners, with practical demonstrations of setting and reading torque values, choosing appropriate drive sizes, and following a proper tightening sequence. The video compares click-type and beam-type wrenches, discusses common errors (such as rapid clicking and using a torque wrench as a breaker bar), and covers maintenance and calibration to preserve accuracy. It also introduces torque-angle gauges for high-torque applications and outlines lug-pattern sequences for multi-lug Wheel.
